rows.details: District Programme Management & Supporting Unit, District Ayush Health Society, National AYUSH Mission, Kasaragod
Ayurveda Therapist, Clinical Psychologist, Multipurpose Health Worker, Yoga Demonstrator, Yoga Instructor and other posts
Rs. 10,500 to Rs. 30,000 monthly consolidated remuneration (varies by post)
AYUSH institutions in Kasaragod District, Kerala

content_sections.heading: About NAM Kasaragod
content_sections.text: The District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU) works under the District Ayush Health Society of the National AYUSH Mission in Kasaragod District, Kerala. Its office is at Padannakkad PO, District Yurveda Hospital, 2nd Floor, Kasaragod 671315 (Mob: 8848002953, Phone: 0467 2288106, Email: [email protected] ). This recruitment is for posts under various AYUSH institutions in Kasaragod District, including physiotherapy units, the NPPMOMD programme and the Ayushgramam Project. The notice is signed by Dr. Dileep K, District Programme Manager, National Ayush Mission, Kasargod.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 17 anticipatory vacancies across nine posts. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints an educational qualification for each post and does not mention any experience requirement. Each post's qualification is given below exactly as printed. The qualifications for the Ayurveda Therapist, Clinical Psychologist, Yoga Demonstrator and Yoga Instructor posts are longer and are listed below. Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by Govt. of Kerala/DAME, or Ayurveda Panchakarma Technician Course with one year duration conducted by CCRAS Cheruthuruthy I.a) M.Sc (Clinical Psychology) or any other equivalent qualification from a UGC recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institute of Government of India. OR M.A / M.Sc Psychology or any other equivalent qualification from a UGC recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India. II. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or any other equivalent 2-year course from a RCI approved University/College/Institution owned by Government of Kerala/National Institutes of Government of India/UGC recognized University. III. Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as Clinical Psychologist. BNYS/BAMS/MSc (Yoga)/MPhil (Yoga) from a recognized University, or PG Diploma in Yoga of Minimum One Year duration from a recognized University, or Approved Certificate course of One year duration in Yoga from a recognized University / Govt. Department/YCB BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences)/BAMS/MSc (Yoga)/MPhil (Yoga)/Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (minimum one year duration) from a recognized University, or Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department/YCB (Yoga Certification Board), or Certificate, Yoga Teacher Training Course of at least one year's duration from the State Resource Centre (SRC), or Diploma in Yogic Science & Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala, or Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) The age limit is counted as on the notification date (25 November 2026). The notice does not mention any minimum age or age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

It does not say which test applies to which post, and no test or interview date is printed. Candidates must produce original documents at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Kasaragod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 17 anticipatory vacancies across nine posts, with the most (4) in Multipurpose Worker (Physiotherapy units) and 3 in Ayurveda Therapist.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kasaragod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NAM Kasaragod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NAM Kasaragod posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 50 years for Ayurveda Therapist and Yoga Instructor, and not exceeding 40 years for all other posts, as on the notification date (25 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in NAM Kasaragod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration ranges from 10500/- for Multipurpose Worker (Ayushgramam Project) to 30,000/- for Clinical Psychologist.

faq.answer: The notice requires Higher Secondary Pass, Computer skills, MS office for Multipurpose Worker (Ayushgramam Project).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NAM Kasaragod posts?
faq.answer: The selection procedure includes Skill Test/Written Test & Interview, as the case may be.

faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications for posts on contract basis, and it describes the vacancies as anticipatory.

faq.answer: Yes, Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as Clinical Psychologist is listed in the qualification for Clinical Psychologist, along with the postgraduate and M.Phil qualifications.
